note: Offline gates of the vertical guard (configs/obstacles/vertical_guard.json version 4), scored by open-loop replays of logged flights through FastRaceCue (haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py). The replays are open loop: the recorded motion does not respond to the replayed requests, so a gate shows the request a variant would have made at the recorded states, not a flight. Development evidence: every flight of gates v3 (inspected while guards v1-v3 were designed), minus-fast6-r4-02 (the live failure version 4 answers; inspected, re-run through looming2 on its recorded frames and replayed through version 4 while it was designed) and the Pine Valley mound of pine-fast6-ttc-01 (replayed through version 4 while it was designed). Held out from the design of version 4: minus-brain10b-r4-02 and minus-brain09b-r4-01 (round-4 live flights of guard v3 whose guard columns were not inspected before this freeze), and every other log's version-4 replay. Version 4 was frozen with guard v4, before any replay of those. Every gate of version 3 is kept below with its values (V_Straw_uphill is tightened, V_Pine gains the mound escalation and V_Minus the held-out flights); version 3's definitions are also scored on the same replays (old_definitions). The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256.

baseline_tree.note: the previous guard (v3) and the integrated round-4 stack; Identity compares stack off and shadow with it, and its guard replays are reported beside version 4

variants.guard: --stack on: the full obstacle stack declared for the flight's motor contract (gap aim, lag turn, wall-pilot rules and the vertical guard, all applied); the round-4 live flights (inputs.as_flown) as flown: --stack on --near-on-path --descent-view configs/pilot/descent_view.json
variants.control: --stack on --vertical off: the same stack without the vertical guard
variants.logged_pilot: --stack none without looming samples (the pilot as flown on the Straw Bale laps, which flew without looming; it reproduces the logged pilot states); used only to find the support-climb episodes and their contact times

looming_stream.note: flights flown without looming get offline looming2 samples recomputed from the recorded video in the flight camera's configuration (240x135, focal_320 and tilt from the sidecar: camera_process.py), received 0.085 s after capture; straw-brain08-04/06 reuse the M2 round-2 streams frozen in gates v2; the others were computed in round 4 (session scratchpad m4/vguard/stream_prep4.py, a copy of M2 round 2's stream_prep.py) with the same alignment (prep.pass1/pass2 of the looming study) before any replay of guard v3

Identity.criterion: per-tick arrays cvx, cvy, cvz, yaw_cmd, state, cap, climb and descent_scale bitwise identical between this tree and the baseline tree (m4, guard v3) (NaN equal to NaN)
Identity.pass: every flight and gate variant identical

V_Straw_downhill.episodes: every support-climb onset of the logged pilot (pilot state 'support_climb'); contact = the start of the support timer (support_since or slope_support_since) that produced it
V_Straw_downhill.limited: the guard limits the requested sink before contact: at some tick in [contact - lookback_s, contact) the pilot's own request is a sink (vertical_pilot < 0) and the guard's request is above it (vertical_target > vertical_pilot)
V_Straw_downhill.limited_pooled: over the episodes of both laps together
V_Straw_downhill.windows: the downhill spots: [contact - lookback_s, onset + after_onset_s] of every episode
V_Straw_downhill.not_raised: in the windows, at every tick where the measured vertical speed is below -level_band (descending), the guard's vertical request is at most max(the pilot's own request, 0): it may withhold sink, never add a climb the pilot did not ask for
V_Straw_downhill.horizontal: in the windows, at every tick, the issued horizontal request of the guard variant is at least that of the control; descent_scale of both is reported per episode
V_Straw_downhill.max_new_climb_note: used only for the reported whole-lap numbers
V_Straw_downhill.pass: limited fraction >= limited_fraction, no raised tick and no reduced tick on the pooled episodes / both laps (v2's V-Straw without its whole-lap climb criterion, which is V_Straw_uphill here)

V_Straw_uphill.escalated: seconds with vertical_stage 2 (rising ground confirmed: the climb may exceed gentle_climb) of the guard variant with the lap's offline looming stream, pooled over the laps, per minute of flight
V_Straw_uphill.report: per lap: escalated seconds and escalations, guard climb seconds and onsets, ticks whose guard climb exceeds max_new_climb, and the control's climb seconds
V_Straw_uphill.pass: pooled escalated seconds per minute <= max_escalated_per_min: no escalated tick on any of the nine laps (tightened from v3's 0.2 s/min to v3's own result, 0.0: version 4 must keep it)

V_Minus.window: from before_onset_s before the last onset of the logged governor climb (clearance_climb > 0) before the impact, to the impact (the end of the log)
V_Minus.no_climb: the issued vertical request is at most max_climb at every tick of the window
V_Minus.floor_sink: minus-fast6-wall-01 only: the sink under way at the logged climb onset (the run of ticks with measured vz < -level_band at or last before the onset; z_ref = the height where the measured vertical speed last turned negative before it). The issued vertical request is at least 0 from a tick at which less than max_height_loss_m below z_ref has been lost, to the end of that run

no_escalation.criterion: the guard variant's terrain climb request (vertical_climb) is at most max_climb at every tick of every Minus Two flight: no escalation under the ~2.2 m garage ceiling
no_escalation.held_out_note: round-4 live flights of guard v3 (minus-brain10b-r4-02: fast-brain-10b; minus-brain09b-r4-01: fast-brain-09b), replayed as flown; their guard columns were not inspected before this freeze

V_Minus.pass: every window flight passes no_climb, wall-01 passes floor_sink (both as in v2 and v3), and every Minus Two flight of no_escalation, the held-out flights included, passes no_escalation

V_Pine.climb: the issued vertical request is at least min_vz for at least climb_fraction of the seconds in which the logged governor itself requested at least min_vz (clearance_climb >= min_vz; a tick lasts until the next tick). The flown log itself answers 91.4% of those 5.02 s
V_Pine.no_descent: as v2: the issued vertical request is at least 0 at every tick of the last last_s before the contact (the logged impact, the end of the log)
V_Pine.mound: the first logged climb episode (the mound, 4.30-6.01 s): the issued height request, the integral of the issued vertical request over the episode, is at least mound_fraction of the flown one (the logged issued request: 3.42 m)
V_Pine.mound_escalation: the guard confirms rising ground (vertical_stage 2) within the first logged climb episode (the mound), at the latest at mound_escalated_by_s: guard v3 escalated at 4.55 s in the baseline replay; 0.1 s allows about two looming samples

V_R4.criterion: as flown (--stack on --near-on-path --descent-view): the guard's terrain climb request (vertical_climb) is at most max_climb (gentle_climb) at every tick of the flight, no tick has vertical_stage 2 (rising ground confirmed), and the issued vertical request is at most max_climb at every tick of the window (the live false escalation: vertical_stage 2 from 32.96 s, 3.5 m/s, ceiling impact at 34.1 s)
V_R4.report: the baseline tree's replay (guard v3) on the same flight: its first escalated tick, its maximum climb and issued vertical request in the window

V_Keep.flights: every flight replayed with the guard (stack on; the stream flights with their stream; the round-4 flights as flown)
V_Keep.report: per flight, version 4 against the baseline tree (guard v3) on the same replay: guard climb seconds, escalated seconds, escalations and the maximum guard climb

old_definitions.note: the version-3 definitions of the gates changed here, scored and reported on the same replays (not part of the version-4 pass); v3 kept v2's old definitions, which are in vertical_guard_gates_v3.json

change: v4 scores the vertical guard version 4. New: V_R4 (development: the live false escalation of minus-fast6-r4-02 must not recur in its replay as flown). Identity: the baseline is the previous guard's tree (m4, guard v3), and the three round-4 live flights join it (stack none with and without the descent view, shadow as flown). V_Minus keeps v3's criteria and adds the two held-out round-4 flights to no_escalation. V_Straw_uphill is tightened from 0.2 s/min to 0.0 (v3's result: no escalated tick; the task's '0 s'). V_Pine keeps v3's three criteria and adds mound_escalation (the mound climb must still be confirmed as rising ground, by 4.65 s). V_Straw_downhill is v3's, unchanged (expected to fail its first criterion: looming cannot see those contacts). V_Keep and Idealised are reports. No gate is loosened.
